registered_source_evidence_rows.short_source: Bovellan M, Romeo Y, Biro M, ... Paluch EK, Charras G (2014) Curr Biol 24(14):1628-1635 · PMID 25017211 · PMC4110400
registered_source_evidence_rows.notes: Native cortical actin mesh architecture (EM). Control (unperturbed) cortex = homogeneous mesh, gap ~30 nm. mDia1 depletion -> high-density patches + 100-200 nm gaps; both nucleators (mDia1 + Arp2/3) perturbed -> loose mesh >100 nm. mDia1 and Arp2/3 each nucleate ~half of cortical F-actin. Cells: HeLa / M2. IMPLICATION for ffn_sim: the KB 'actin mesh ~100 nm' (KB-3.1/3.18) is the PERTURBED/loose value, NOT native; native ~30 nm. This vindicates the 70,686 count MAGNITUDE (implied mesh ~34 nm, native regime) and RETRACTS the earlier 'count too dense' concern. Registered per PI 2026-07-21. See docs/v2_audit/CORTEX_COUNT_CROSSCHECK_2026-07-21.md. TODO (PI-gated KB edit): re-label KB-3.1/3.18 mesh 100 nm as perturbed + add native 30 nm.

conditions.cells: Filamin-deficient M2 melanoma mature cortex and retracting blebs
conditions.assay: GFP-actin FRAP / photoactivatable actin FLAP; subtract fast diffusive recovery; circular bleach radius1µm

source_cards.finding: Control Table1: rates1.38±0.1/s and0.04±0.01/s, fast fraction0.69±0.06. Text reports recovery half-time12.8±1s; Table2 reports8.6±1s for cortical FRAP and an effective0.04±0.01/s. Their coexistence is retained. Background20-25s cites earlier studies. Table1 exact0.03/s is a slow component under1µM cytochalasin D, not an unperturbed whole-cortex constant.
source_cards.limits: Single exponential identity is τ=1/k and t1/2=ln2/k; mixture summaries do not obey a one-rate reduction. Frozen observer counts live→dead nodes per time, a different numerator/denominator. SE110 has blank DOI and NO_DOI_FOUND; this candidate DOI is not a registry repair. Report-level half-time differences are retained without asserting the same cohort or an error. A scalar0.03/s could approximately correspond to ln(2)/(20–30s)=0.0231–0.0347/s under a single-exponential half-time interpretation; this possible approximation does not establish the declaration’s exact derivation or equivalence to the node-based observer.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Primary plus/minus values preserved; no SD/SEM type or source-wide aggregation inferred beyond inspected captions. Different main-text/Table2 half-times and N remain unresolved; the inspected text does not establish identical cohort membership. Fig.2B/D curve error bars are labeled SD, but that alone does not determine the meaning of ± attached to Table1 fitted rates.

registered_source_evidence_rows.notes: Cytosim theory/simulation of disordered actomyosin cortex networks (the reference engine lineage for ffn_sim filament mechanics). METHODOLOGICAL anchor: filament count is SET EXPLICITLY, not derived from concentration/geometry -- e.g. ~1,500 filaments over a circular patch of radius 15 um (~707 um^2) = ~2 filaments/um^2, chosen to reproduce network mechanics. Also: contractile networks are intrinsically pulsatile IF filaments turn over (relevant to the cortical short-filament/turnover fidelity gap). IMPLICATION for ffn_sim: 'areal density x surface = 70,686' is one convention, not the field standard; the 100/um^2 areal density is a modeling choice, and 70,686 x 3um are coarse REPRESENTATIVE filaments, not a short-filament census. Registered per PI 2026-07-21. See docs/v2_audit/CORTEX_COUNT_CROSSCHECK_2026-07-21.md.
